headline: Job hunting isn't broken. The system reading your CV is.
subline: See exactly how each ATS will read your resume. Fix it in minutes.
caption_linkedin:
Most rejection emails are not personal. They are not even human.

The majority of job applications never reach a hiring manager. They are filtered by an ATS — Applicant Tracking System — looking for keywords, formats, and signals you were never told to include.

If you have been applying and hearing nothing back, it is probably not your experience. It is probably the system reading you.

Spark Careers shows you, role by role, exactly how each job's ATS will score your CV. Then it tells you what to change so you make it through. Five minutes per application. Free.

headline: The fastest way to lose a great hire is to follow up four days late.
caption_linkedin:
Here is the unglamorous trade secret of hiring well at a small company: speed of follow-up beats almost every other variable.

The best candidates are talking to multiple companies. The window between application and first reply is when they decide whether you are serious. Four days is too long. Two days is borderline. Same-day puts you in a different league.

This is why a real workspace matters. Not for the candidate. For you. So when an application lands, the right person sees it that hour, not next Tuesday when they finally scroll the inbox.

Spark Careers Enterprise pings the right person the moment a candidate comes in, on any channel. Time-to-first-reply collapses. You hire the people who would have gone elsewhere.

headline: Every well-targeted application is one closer. Trust the math.
caption_linkedin:
Job hunting is a numbers game and a precision game at the same time. Most people only play one.

The numbers part: apply more. Send out more well-targeted applications. Every one is a roll of the dice that can pay off.

The precision part: the dice are loaded by what's on your CV vs. what the role asks for. Generic CVs lose to specific ones every time.

Spark Careers handles the precision part so you can focus on the volume. Tailored CV per role, ATS score per application, all in five minutes.

Keep applying. The right one is closer than yesterday.
